Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly modeled the game. They (a) assumed Bob could guess the exact coin counts despite not knowing the distribution or box ordering (ignoring the need for a worst-case, maximin strategy against an adversarial arrangement), and (b) improperly restricted the valid distributions by forcing c = a + 6 with sorted boxes, missing many allowed configurations. These errors led to the unjustified conclusion that Bob can guarantee winning all 30 coins ($30,000).
